name: gcp
summary: Short-lived GCP access token for one service account, by impersonation (no key) or from a key file

secrets.prompt: GCP credentials JSON — impersonated_service_account (no key, may need periodic re-login) or service_account (key file, never expires)

config.help: Full email, e.g. dev-ai-agent@my-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com. Cross-checked against the ADC file — its impersonation URL, or client_email for a key file: a mismatch is refused rather than silently preferred. Deployment configuration — the lab container does not choose which identity it gets, so two identities means two deployments.
